name: Dying Light: The Beast - Hunter Essentials
summary:
Stealth takedowns are front and centre with he Hush crossbow delivering silent death, while the Trapper outfit ensures you blend into the forests of Castor Wood. A single-use UV bar, Temporary XP Booster and military Medi kit will offer further advantages against the horde. The set is completed with a Villedor weapon charm to remind you why you fight.

Hunter Essentials contains:
- Hush Crossbow
- Trapper Gear Parts
- Villedor Weapon Charm
- 3x Military Medkit
- 5x UV Bar
- 3x Temporary XP Boost
